about: The 3-layer Inkling mini (/mnt/models/inkling-small-mini, L294) on its uniform K3 EXL3 pack: every attention / dense / shared / routed Linear exl3m_k3 from --exl3, byte copies of the pack. The head BF16 from the checkpoint (the pack's K6 head has no engine arm yet); norms, short convs, relative bases, router, scales, embed and the hmlp tower in their source dtype. The mini has no drafter.
